messages:
maria: Heads up — we had a customer-triggered export storm this morning that saturated the export job queue and delayed presigned download links for ~15m. Thinking we should add a streaming "compact diff" option to the console + API-level backpressure and priority tiers. Ideas?

jack: Oof. Any link to the incident log? Was it many concurrent full-archive requests or repeated retries?

maria: It was a mix — a tenant kicked off 12 overlapping full export jobs + a scheduled daily export. Retries from the client made it worse. Link: https://internal/incidents/17894 — summary in the incident thread.

product-olive: From product POV customers mostly want immediate visibility for rollouts: "who changed what in the last 24h" not the full blob. If we can show a tiny preview (first 50 diffs) and then let them stream the rest, that solves most UX asks.

sre-jun: Agree. Operationally we need: per-tenant token-bucket quota for exports, a low-cost "preview" path that streams compact NDJSON, and job prioritization for entitlement tiers. Also queue-length and export-latency metrics to alert.

liam: API proposal sketch (very rough):

```
POST /v1/audit/exports
{
  "scope": "tenant|org",
  "since": "2026-03-18T00:00:00Z",
  "mode": "full|compact_stream|preview",
  "stream": true,         # if true return 202 + resume/ws url or SSE
  "signing": "none|sha256-chain",
  "presigned_ttl_seconds": 900
}

Response 202:
{
  "job_id": "jid_123",
  "status_url": "/v1/audit/exports/jid_123",
  "sse_url": "/v1/audit/exports/jid_123/stream"    # optional
}
```

maria: Nice. I prefer SSE/chunked HTTP for simplicity — easier on load balancers than websockets. Also include resume token so UI can reconnect mid-stream.

anna: How do we handle PII/redaction for the preview path? Preview should apply tenant redaction rules, but we also need an option for "legal" full export with stricter auth.

compliance-bot: Requirements from compliance:
- All downloads must be auditable (actor + timestamp + job_id).
- If tenant requests signed proof, sign each stream chunk with tenant key and include merkle-root header when job completes.
- Presigned links default TTL 15m; enterprise contracts may allow longer.

jack: Implementation caution: long-lived SSEs mean threads holding kernel fds + memory. We probably need a stream worker pool with limited concurrency and backpressure at the edge. Also avoid buffering entire job in memory — stream from the export producer with small buffers.

liam: For compact format, suggest NDJSON lines like:

```
{"ts":"2026-03-18T01:12:34Z","actor":"user:12345","actor_alias":"j.smith","action":"update","target":"route:payments","diff":"path:rules[3] -> {enabled:false}"}
```

and for preview we truncate values and redact email-like strings: "actor_alias":"j.***".

product-olive: Console UX: show first 10 items inline (fast), banner for "streaming remaining results" with estimated size. If streaming fails, fallback to queued full-download with presigned link and explicit quota cost warning.

sre-jun: Quota semantics: streaming counts MB served against export quota; preview counts as a small fixed cost (e.g., 5 units). Add owner-priority override for legal/incident requests but gate with approval webhook.

anna: For legal holds we need an auditable reason field on the export job: who requested and why. That should be part of job metadata and included in the exported proof header.

liam: I'll draft an OpenAPI patch with SSE/resume tokens + job metadata fields. Any opinions on default presigned TTL? Maria suggested 15m; product asked for optional enterprise override.

maria: 15m default is fine. For Dedicated tenants, allow config to extend to 24h via contract flag.

compliance-bot: Also: stash a small signed manifest (JSON) with job_id, merkle_root, requestor_id, and retention period. That manifest should be immutable and exportable.

jack: Ops note — we should surface these export jobs in the console's Activity/Jobs panel with cancel + priority buttons (if you have permission). That helps humans stop runaway exports quickly.

product-olive: UX note — add a small "cost estimate" before running an export (preview will show low cost; full export will show MB estimate based on since/scope).

maria: Action items: liam -> PR for API + SSE/resume (ETA EOD Thurs). sre-jun -> add queue-length & export-bytes metrics + pager rule (>80% queue). anna -> confirm redaction/manifest schema with compliance. I'll file the roadmap ticket and include incident links. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sre-jun: ping @infra-deploy-bot to run a canary of stream workers once we have a branch.

infra-deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: canary/exports-streaming-2026-03-19 (will run after PR merge).
